question.text: Fund PQC is Market-Neutral. After one week, Company B (long, Beta 0.40) rallies 30% and Company D (short, Beta 1.20) rallies 5%. What is the FIRST thing the manager should check/do?

answer.text: Increase leverage to 2x to amplify gains.
Recompute portfolio Beta with updated weights; rebalance positions to restore Beta ~ 0.

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.1.1.3 explicitly warns that individual stock price movements change weights and force Beta away from zero — the manager must REBALANCE to restore Beta ~ 0. This is the ongoing maintenance cost of market-neutral. The Trap: A ignores the mandate. C is an over-reaction. D breaks leverage discipline. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C same. XXI-B analogous rebalance rules.
